mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM um_userinfo u INNER JOIN um_user_identity_rel r ON r.userinfo_id = u.id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.identity_type = 'buy' AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.audit_status = 2 AND u.is_blacklisted = 0 AND u.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND u.id > #{lastId} ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT #{size}
